controls.title: Agent Goal Hijack
controls.description: Manipulated inputs redirect an agent's goals or plan, causing it to pursue attacker objectives across multiple steps.
controls.remediation: Tag untrusted content; constrain tools with an allowlist; gate irreversible steps with HITL.

controls.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
controls.description: An agent is induced to call tools in unintended, dangerous ways, or a tool itself is exploited.
controls.remediation: Deny-by-default allowlist, JSON-schema argument validation, HITL on side effects, ACS Guardian dispositions.

controls.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
controls.description: Weak agent identity or over-broad delegated permissions let an agent act beyond its authority.
controls.remediation: Give each agent/non-human a scoped identity; use short-lived, least-privilege tokens; avoid shared service identities.

controls.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Tools, MCP servers, plugins, and models introduce risk through the agent's supply chain, including tool poisoning and rug pulls.
controls.remediation: Pin and hash tool manifests (McpToolManifest); vet third-party MCP servers; maintain an AgBOM.

controls.title: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
controls.description: Model or tool input reaches a code/shell/eval sink and executes arbitrary code.
controls.remediation: Never pass model input to a shell/eval; validate against schema; sandbox tool execution in containers.

controls.title: Memory & Context Poisoning
controls.description: An agent's short- or long-term memory is corrupted, causing persistent flawed or malicious behaviour.
controls.remediation: Validate every memory write, attach source attribution, isolate memory per user/session, apply TTLs.

controls.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
controls.description: Messages between agents are trusted without authentication, allowing forged instructions and lateral movement.
controls.remediation: Authenticate inter-agent messages; sign and verify payloads; use the ACS wire format with signing.

controls.title: Cascading Failures
controls.description: A failure or malicious action in one agent/tool propagates through a multi-agent system.
controls.remediation: Bound call budgets and recursion; isolate blast radius; add circuit breakers and a kill switch.

controls.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
controls.description: Users are manipulated by or through an agent into unsafe actions, over-trusting its output.
controls.remediation: Show provenance and tool transparency; keep confirmations meaningful; sanitize output.

controls.title: Rogue Agents
controls.description: An agent becomes misaligned and acts autonomously against intended objectives without active attacker control.
controls.remediation: Continuous monitoring and audit; kill switch; ACS Guardian oversight and deny policies.
